entry.title: [要確認] npm: Mongoose: sanitizeFilter not applied on countDocuments (CRITICAL)
entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：要確認 MongooseのsanitizeFilterがcountDocumentsで効かない。この設定に頼る場合のみ影響
→ 6.13.11 / 7.8.12 / 8.24.3 / 9.9.2 以降に更新

mongoose < 6.13.11 → 6.13.11, mongoose >= 7.0.0, < 7.8.12 → 7.8.12, mongoose >= 8.0.0, < 8.24.3 → 8.24.3, mongoose >= 9.0.0, < 9.9.2 → 9.9.2

CVE-2026-125120
